messages:
mira: quick heads-up  planning cross-service deploy tonight 23:00 UTC. services: api:v2026-03-30.1, runtime:2.3.1, router:0.9.5, console:1.12.0. need pin + rollback sign-off.

sam: please pin runtime:2.3.1 for hosted + dedicated; fallback runtime:2.2.8. saw kv eviction spikes last rollout.

jordan: sequence: api -> runtime -> router -> console. router header-split will be toggled in canary policy. no DB migrations.

mira: canary plan: 5% x15m, 25% x10m, 100%. stagger 60s between service steps.

rita: rollback auto-triggers: api 5xx >0.5% sustained 5m OR p50 +75ms for 10m OR runtime OOMs/kv-evict >3x baseline. manual abort: /deploy abort <run-id>. notify #incidents on auto-rollback.

sam: also add console visual smoke (grep `render_error`) and watch tokenization diffs for kernel-quant. quant kernel only in canary.

mira: pins set. deploy will run via deploy-bot: /deploy orchestrate --services api,runtime,router,console --canary 5 --canary-duration 15m --staged 25,100 --stagger 60s --pin runtime:2.3.1 --fallback runtime:2.2.8 --tag v2026-03-30.1

deploy-bot: scheduled run 20260330-11 by mira at 2026-03-30T23:00:00Z. Canary started when triggered; monitoring hooks attached.

mira: starting in ~10m. if anyone wants to hold speak now.

jordan: ready; will watch header-split and route failback.

rita: ops abort snippet for runbook: /deploy abort 20260330-11 --reason "auto-threshold" ; /deploy promote fallback --services runtime --version 2.2.8

mira: will update release_notes.md after completion. :white_check_mark:
